cautions.quote: The moment you create a new company that is not a Cronus demo company, the Business Central trial starts.
If a Business Central trial environment is created but no one signs in at all for 45 days, Microsoft may automatically remove the environment.
Using a personal Microsoft account or an email address from an existing tenant often leads to inconsistent results.
Business Central is not available in every country, and not every country supports Microsoft provided localizations.
